messages.author: 9ba858f97bd37c2a
messages.subject: gl2fasta file missing
parts:
Hello all, 

I am trying to get a fasta file using gl2fasta... after I filter my data, but each time I run the code, no file appears. I have set the working directory, I don't get any error messages, and the run indicates "completed" at the end. This also happens when I attempt to use gl2snapp() and gl2svdquartets() too. 

Can anyone help me figure out if I'm doing something wrong? Do I have to do a second export? I'm using the "outfile" option. 

Thank you!

-Alvaro

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: gl2fasta file missing
parts:
Hello Alvaro:

Can you try installing the developing version of dartR:

> library(dartR)
> gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "dev")
# Restart your R session: Menu > Session > Restart R
> library(dartR)
> gl.filter.maf(bandicoot.gl)

> gl <- gl.filter.reproducibility(testset.gl,t=1)
> gl <- gl.filter.overshoot(gl,verbose=3)
> gl <- gl.filter.callrate(testset.gl,t=.98)
> gl <- gl.filter.monomorphs(gl)
> gl2fasta(gl, method=1, outfile='test.fasta',verbose=3,outpath = getwd())

Cheers,
Luis
